olivia: Heads-up // Sentinel Systems pilot escalated to execs. Theyre stipulating three must-haves before board sign-off: (1) BYO KMS with HSM attestation, (2) mutual TLS to their gov gateway using their internal CA (no public CA), and (3) a committed throughput quote with SLA for a 9-month pilot. Need rapid alignment.

sam: SE: We can run a private control plane in their VPC and terminate mTLS there, presenting their client certs. Two open items: cert rotation process + acceptance of our proxy topology. Also need to confirm FIPS requirement.

devin: I prototyped a lightweight proxy (nginx) that presents an agency-supplied client cert to the gateway. Will push to POC repo with README. Snippet: ```
server {
  listen 443 ssl;
  ssl_certificate /etc/sentinel/client.pem;
  ssl_certificate_key /etc/sentinel/client.key;
  proxy_pass https://redwood-internal:8443;
}
```

marco: Ops note: zero-egress runtime will break our normal telemetry. Recommend secure log relay into their SIEM and a heartbeat to console via control plane. Document degradation tradeoffs in the runbook.

contracts-bot: Legal flag: Security questionnaire Q12 needs explicit key custody language. They require BYOK with HSM attestation and audit log export. Contracts requested draft addendum.

sec-bot: Security scan results: IL4 controls detected. Required items: zero-egress runtime, KMS BYO, FIPS-validated crypto in transit and at rest. Created ticket SEC-1147.

olivia: GTM ask: Pricing team needs committed throughput model for 800k tokens/day and ~1.5k concurrent sessions. Two scenarios: (A) 9-month reserved with discount + SLA, (B) PAYG with burst cap. Finance please produce draft delta by Tue EOD.

sam: Ill produce the network diagram + cert rotation cadence doc by EOD today. If customer insists on on-prem control plane we should surface extra ops hours during the sync.

devin: Pushing proxy + README now. Ill demo rotation automation Thu 09:30 PT.

marco: I need the runbook input by Thu AM to lock down monitoring changes.

contracts-bot: Contracts will draft the BYOK addendum; need Q12 answers and sample HSM attestation from customer. ETA Wed AM.

olivia: Proposed internal prep sync Wed 13:00 PT to finalize diagram, runbook, and pricing before the customer steering. Confirm availability.
